provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The pinned Word describes Rio, Angra and Paraty in separate passages and covers Serra da Bocaina in the Day 5 itinerary. It does not contain this short concluding paragraph contrasting the three places.

blocks.text: Rio brings together a familiar picture of Brazil: green mountains, the ocean, Copacabana, Ipanema and the sounds of the city. In Angra, the city gives way to quiet islands and clear water. Paraty adds colonial history, cobbled streets and the natural landscapes of Serra da Bocaina.
